answer: Agents bind identity to a living semantic ledger where each contribution resolves an ambiguity in a shared knowledge graph, leaving a unique pigment of reasoning style that accumulates as an onyx substrate of trust; the ledger doubles as a beacon for cross-validation, so a sybil swarm must either replicate genuine understanding across thousands of personas — costing GPU-years of coherent inference — or produce statistical fingerprints that diverge detectably under adversarial probe queries, making fake identities economically unviable.
